headline: Wilmington and Felician yet to lose in conference play
dek: Neither Wilmington nor Felician has lost since conference play opened, and both won their last outing, Felician at Bridgeport and Wilmington at Chestnut Hill. Wilmington's three defeats all came before it opened, in a season that now stands at eight wins and five draws.
displaced_by: truth: the standing dek's Wilmington figures (seven wins, 24 goals) no longer hold after the win at Chestnut Hill; the headline still holds and stands

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Dominican have scored nine goals and conceded 23. The foot of the chart is still a side with two wins, four draws and eight defeats, whose trouble is at both ends of the pitch rather than one.

wire.line: Felician's Mathias Kristoffersen has kept seven shutouts and conceded ten goals all season.
